reviews.text: This has got to be my new fave shade out of the glasting melting balm line (Scotch Nude). I used to use nougat sand everyday with a pinky mauve liner for that pinky nude MLBB look (mind you, I’m a Sand girly in most korean foundations [neutral-warm toned during summers]), but ever since I got this scotch nude shade, I’ve ditched my liner pencil+nougat sand routine and just used this all on it’s own as it gives me that same color combo in one swipe. This is def more pigmented than the rest of the line (and it looks extra pigmented in the packaging) but still is a bit sheer as it is a balm. The formula does not dry out my lips, as I have experienced with their dewyful water tint line…though, if you are looking for that pigmented look, def try that line!
reviews.zh: 呢個一定係 glasting melting balm 系列入面我最新嘅最愛色（Scotch Nude）。我以前每日都用 nougat sand，再配粉紫色嘅唇線筆，去做粉嫩裸色 MLBB 效果（要講明，我用嘅大部分韓國粉底都係 Sand 色號嘅女仔［夏天時偏中性偏暖調］），不過自從我有咗呢個 scotch nude 色號，我就唔用唇線筆＋nougat sand 嗰套，淨係用呢支就得，一掃就有同樣嘅顏色組合。呢個色比系列入面其他色都更加有色素（包裝上睇落都更加有色素），不過因為係唇膏，仲係有少少透。呢個配方唔會令我嘅嘴唇乾燥，唔似我用過佢哋 dewyful water tint 系列嗰種經驗……不過，如果你想要更有色素嘅效果，一定要試吓嗰個系列！

reviews.text:
love this color and formula! I really enjoy how it feels on the lips and I've found it to last quite long for a balm. also love how shiny/glossy these are! I also have shade 07 mauve whip which is a pink mauve tone, both are gorgeous on the lips, but i will say they are definitely more pigmented than they appear in the product photos. 
I did about three or four swipes in photos that I attached
reviews.zh:
好鍾意呢款顏色同配方！我好享受佢搽喺唇上嗰種感覺，而且作為一款唇膏，我覺得佢持久得幾耐。亦好鍾意佢哋嘅光亮／油亮效果！我仲有 07 mauve whip 色號，係粉紫色調，兩款搽喺唇上都好靚，不過我一定要講，佢哋嘅色素比產品相上睇落濃好多。
我相入面大約掃咗三至四次。

reviews.text: I love this glasting melting balm. It’s perfect! It does not cause any discomfort and has just the right amount of pigmentation. It’s moisturizing and lasts long (up to ~3 hours from my experience so long as you’re not eating or drinking). It’s also not too glossy! I’ve attached a picture but this is the kaya fig on top of foundation and how it shows on me. Like all lip products, it will apply and show differently depending on how much is applied and if there is foundation already on lips or not. I only applied 1 layer here. My lips are hella small n thin so it usually looks strange if it’s too matte or too glossy. I originally purchased the kaya fig color as I am an ambiguous tone (not completely cool or warm though I think I lean more towards cool). This was the right choice! I still purchased more in other colors because it’s such an amazing product.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款 glasting melting balm。完美！搽落唔會有任何不適，色素啱啱好。保濕，持久力都好（根據我嘅經驗，只要唔食嘢或者飲嘢，可以維持大約 3 個鐘）。都唔會太油亮！我附咗張相，呢張係 kaya fig 疊喺粉底上面嘅效果，即係我實際上嘅樣子。好似所有唇部產品一樣，搽嘅量同唇上有冇粉底，都會影響效果。呢度我只係搽咗一層。我嘅嘴唇好細、好薄，所以如果太啞光或者太油亮，通常都會睇落怪怪地。我本身購入 kaya fig 色，係因為我嘅膚色底調唔太明確（唔完全係冷調或者暖調，不過我覺得我偏冷多啲）。呢個選擇係啱嘅！我仲另外買咗其他顏色，因為佢實在係好正嘅產品。

reviews.text: I didn’t like it and it’s not like what’s described I thought it would be a glossy melting balm but it’s just a lip balm with color and if I wanted that glossy effect I’d have ti apply a lot which by then would look ugly :( jo
reviews.zh: 我唔鍾意，同描述唔一樣。我以為會係一款亮澤嘅 melting balm，但係佢只係一支有色嘅護唇膏。如果我想要嗰種亮澤效果，就要塗好多，到嗰陣就會好難睇 :( jo

reviews.text:
TLDR: not particularly hydrating, good colour payoff, lasts a good amount of time. A worthwhile purchase

As someone who isn’t used to makeup, I found it rather sticky, which I don’t like, but I think that’s probably to be expected (?). The colour payoff is really good even on someone with super pigmented lips, and the colour I chose (kaya fig) is rather natural on me. It needs reapplication after about 4 hours or after eating, but I also think that is to be expected. Personally, I didn’t find it particularly hydrating but not drying either which is good because I have very dry lips. After I swatched it on my wrist, it stained my wrist after trying to wash it off with soap and water
reviews.zh:
重點（TLDR）：保濕力一般，發色好，持久時間都幾長。值得買

作為一個唔太習慣化妝嘅人，我覺得佢幾黏，我唔鍾意，不過我諗呢個應該係正常嘅（？）。就算係唇色好有色素嘅人，發色效果都好好，而且我揀嘅 kaya fig 色喺我身上都幾自然。大約 4 個鐘或者食嘢之後就要補搽，不過我都覺得呢個應該係正常。我個人覺得佢唔算特別保濕，但都唔會乾，呢點好好，因為我嘅嘴唇好乾。我喺手腕試色之後，用肥皂同水想洗走，但手腕仲係被染色咗。

reviews.text:
it did take me a minute to like this balm only because when i first put it on i thought did color didn’t look good on me but after the color like settle onto my lips i knew this would be a balm i can see myself wearing for days i just want a mascara and lip balm look 

i was pretty surprised to know that this color would show up in my two tone lips compared with my brown skin tone 

also this color doesn’t last long if you eat or drink anything while wearing it but that’s understandable since it’s a balm and not a lip tint
reviews.zh:
我花咗一陣時間先鍾意呢款唇膏，因為我第一次搽嗰陣，覺得個色睇落唔太啱我。不過等顏色穩定落唇上之後，我就知道呢款係我會連續好幾日都用嘅唇膏，我只係想要睫毛膏加唇膏咁嘅妝容。

我好驚訝，原來呢個顏色喺我嘅唇色深淺唔均勻嘅雙色唇上（同我嘅啡色膚色比較）都能夠顯色。

另外，如果你搽住呢款嘅時候食嘢或者飲嘢，個色都唔會持得耐，不過呢點都可以理解，因為佢係唇膏，唔係唇染。

reviews.text: I have summer cool skin, so I've been wanting to get a cooler tone lip balm. This is great for people who like that sheer hydrated look. Note that to get the look like in the pictures, you'll have to put a LOT on. I have a picture of my lips before and after, and it took about 3 full swipes to get that coverage. It lasts about 2-3 hours on my lips without drinking things or eating things, so that's pretty good. If you have dead skin, it def gathers that.
reviews.zh: 我係夏季冷調（summer cool）膚色，所以一直想搵一款冷色調嘅唇膏。呢款好啱鍾意透明水潤效果嘅人。注意，如果想達到相入面嗰種效果，你要搽好多。我有一張塗前同塗後嘅相，大約掃咗三次完整嘅量，先達到嗰種覆蓋力。我嘅嘴唇喺唔飲嘢、唔食嘢嘅情況下，大約可以維持 2至3 個鐘，所以都幾好。如果你嘅嘴唇有死皮，佢一定會卡喺死皮上面。

reviews.text:
Such a lovely lip balm. It has a very nice coverage and it’s lasting power is AMAZING! Obviously rubs off if you are eating or drinking, but if not, this WILL stay in place. 
I must said it won’t give you any obvious stain, or at least that’s the case with the shades I own (Coco Nude and Nougat Sand).
It feels moisturizing and has a pleasant sweet smell to it.
The shine on this balm is insane, so if you are going for that plump juicy lip this is your best choice.
Highly recommend it!
reviews.zh:
真係好可愛嘅唇膏。覆蓋力好好，持久力超正！當然，如果食嘢或者飲嘢，都會褪晒，但係如果冇，咁佢一定會留喺度。
我一定要講，佢唔會留低任何明顯嘅染色，最少我擁有嘅色號（Coco Nude 同 Nougat Sand）係咁。
搽落有保濕感，仲有啲令人舒服嘅甜香味。
呢款唇膏嘅光澤感勁到不得了，所以如果你想要豐潤多汁嘅嘴唇效果，呢款係你嘅最佳之選。
極力推薦！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
